b: I recently joined a mid-sized consumer company and I’m figuring out how we should set up our owned messaging channels (email, SMS, push, maybe WhatsApp).

At my last company we had a pretty basic setup on Mailchimp, so I’d love to know what others are using and whether it’s actually working for you. Are you on a paid tool, something your team built in-house, or getting by on free plans?
A few things I’m especially curious about:
What made you pick that setup over the alternatives?
What’s working well, and what’s been a pain?
If you switched tools at some point, what made you switch?
And if you don’t mind sharing, what kind of company you’re at (size, industry), just for me to get a sense of whether it will work for a company like ours.
